name: Q-Bench-Video
description: Q-Bench-Video evaluates a model's ability to understand and answer questions about short video clips, measuring multimodal comprehension including visual grounding, temporal reasoning, and scene understanding. It focuses on alignment between video content and natural language queries, testing both factual and commonsense inferences from frame sequences. The benchmark is intended to assess video-question answering and retrieval capabilities of multimodal models.
reputation: A niche, emerging benchmark in the multimodal/video QA community with limited but growing usage.
